name: Project Import Export
description: Export a full-fidelity Forska project package and import it as a new project on another machine without breaking provider, model, article, prompt, judgment, human-judgment, or review relationships.

userStories.title: Add transfer history migration and types
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a persisted project transfer history store so import analyze can warn on exact package reimports without merging projects automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration for `app.project_transfer_history` with direction, package fingerprint, schema version, source project summary, target project id, payload counts, and created-at fields.
Add typed schema records for transfer history so project-transfer services can read and write the table without ad hoc row parsing.

userStories.title: Define manifest schema and fingerprint helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want first-class manifest and fingerprint helpers so export and import can share one stable package contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add project-transfer schema helpers for `manifest.json`, payload metadata, warning codes, and project summary fields.
Add SHA-256 checksum helpers and a stable `packageFingerprint` builder that excludes volatile fields such as timestamps and byte sizes.
Equivalent payloads produce the same fingerprint even when exported at different times.

userStories.title: Add zip, path, and session contract helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want shared zip-safety and session-state helpers so transfer routes can reject unsafe archives and report progress consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add helpers that validate normalized archive member paths, allow only the locked payload file list plus `assets/**`, and reject absolute paths, `..` traversal, symlinks, and duplicate normalized entries.
Add typed helpers for import and export session states, progress payloads, temp layout metadata, and expiry timestamps.
The shared helpers are reusable by both export and import services instead of being embedded in route handlers.

userStories.title: Mount project transfer route shell
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a dedicated route module for package transfer so the new API surface stays separate from the existing CSV export flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/routes/ProjectTransferRoutes.ts` with typed endpoint shells for export, session status, download, analyze, dependency resolution, commit, and cancel.
Mount the new route module in `src/server/index.ts` without changing the existing CSV export route contract.
Route responses expose consistent session and progress shapes even before later stories fill in the full service logic.

userStories.title: Assemble export manifest and core JSON payloads
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want export assembly for project, provider, model, and prompt payloads so package creation has a stable non-asset core.
acceptanceCriteria: Export `project.json`, `providers.json`, `models.json`, and `prompts.json` with sanitized provider descriptors, project prompt fields, and omission warnings from the plan.
Manifest generation records row counts and checksums for the core JSON payloads.
Exported provider and model descriptors contain enough safe identity data for later import matching without exporting secrets.

userStories.title: Export article, judgment, and review NDJSON payloads
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the relational project data written as NDJSON payloads so imports can preserve article and review state without trusting source ids.
acceptanceCriteria: Export `articles.ndjson`, `judgments.ndjson`, `judgmentAssessments.ndjson`, `humanJudgments.ndjson`, `humanJudgmentSummaries.ndjson`, and `reviews.ndjson` for the selected project.
Only active judgments where `deleted_at IS NULL` are exported, and linked assessment, human-judgment, summary, and review rows are scoped to the exported project data.
Manifest checksums and counts include the NDJSON payloads written by this story.

userStories.title: Collect export assets and rewrite metadata
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want local article assets copied into the package with safe metadata so import can restore runtime-backed files on another machine.
acceptanceCriteria: Collect local article PDFs and related exported assets into `assets/` instead of only exporting stored path strings.
Record enough metadata for import-time path rewriting while rejecting missing or unsafe asset sources.
Asset paths stay relative to runtime-writable storage semantics rather than repo-root assumptions.

userStories.title: Add export endpoints for inline and background downloads
userStories.description: As a user, I want project export endpoints that return a file immediately for small packages and a tracked session for large packages so downloads stay responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/projects/:id/export-project` returns a direct package response for small exports and `202 Accepted` session metadata for large exports.
Add session status and download endpoints that expose preparing and ready states and serve completed package files from temp storage.
Background export sessions reuse the same package assembly services and cleanup rules as inline export.

userStories.title: Wire Export Project into the projects grid
userStories.description: As a Forska user, I want an Export Project action in the projects grid so I can download a full-fidelity transfer package without affecting CSV export.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an `Export Project` action beside the existing `Export data` action in `src/components/main/ProjectsGrid.tsx`.
Small exports download directly from the grid, and background exports show a visible preparing state until the package is ready.
The existing `Export data` CSV flow remains unchanged.
Verify in browser: `Export Project` appears beside `Export data` and a small export downloads a `.forska-project.zip` file
Verify in browser: a large export shows a preparing state and downloads when ready

userStories.title: Create import upload sessions in runtime temp storage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want import uploads streamed into server-owned temp sessions so large packages do not live only in browser memory.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/projects/import/analyze` creates an import session and streams the uploaded zip into runtime-writable temp storage.
Import sessions track TTL, session directory layout, package size limits, and cleanup hooks for cancel, expiry, and failure.
The route contract returns session ids and progress metadata instead of writing main-table rows during upload.

userStories.title: Validate and extract uploaded packages with progress
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want import analyze to validate archive safety and extraction progress so unsafe or oversized packages fail before any write begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Import analyze validates `manifest.json`, checksum expectations, allowed payload paths, and archive member safety before extraction completes.
Small packages can analyze inline, while large packages move through queued, extracting, and analyzing phases with monotonic progress fields.
Extracted files land under the session temp layout defined in Phase 1 rather than under the repo root.

userStories.title: Analyze package summary and duplicate history warnings
userStories.description: As a user, I want import analyze to summarize the package and warn on exact duplicates so I can review the package before starting dependency resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze returns project summary, payload counts, omission warnings, and exact-duplicate warning details based on `packageFingerprint` and transfer history.
Analyze also returns overlap summary fields for reused articles, new articles, omitted route links, duplicate import matches, and post-remap blocking conflicts.
Duplicate-package warnings remain informational and do not merge or overwrite existing projects automatically.

userStories.title: Auto-match provider connections safely
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want provider auto-match to reuse only safe target connections so imported packages never silently bind to disabled or non-selectable dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider connection matching requires provider kind plus a safe connection fingerprint and only succeeds for enabled target connections.
Analyze returns unresolved or ambiguous dependency states when a matching connection would still leave required models disabled or non-selectable.
Machine-local settings such as manual worker URLs remain review hints and are not silently trusted as final imported defaults.

userStories.title: Materialize missing non-Codex and Codex models
userStories.description: As a user, I want missing imported models resolved through the existing provider flows so project import can reuse normal model setup instead of inventing a second credential path.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-Codex missing models are created or confirmed through `/api/provider-connections/:id/models` or `/api/provider-connections/:id/sync-models` as appropriate.
Codex-backed models remain blocked until Codex setup is complete and `POST /api/models/ensure` materializes the required target models.
The resolved model mapping covers the project model and every judgment model referenced by the package.

userStories.title: Analyze article overlap and route-link conflicts
userStories.description: As a user, I want article reuse and route omissions analyzed conservatively so ambiguous matches block import instead of silently linking the wrong records.
acceptanceCriteria: Article matching follows the exact identifier priority from the plan and returns the matched identifier type together with all exact candidates when secondary identifiers produce multiple matches.
Analyze reports reused article count, new article count, and omitted route-link count without heuristic auto-linking.
Blocking article ambiguities or route-link decisions remain unresolved until the user reviews them.

userStories.title: Build import upload and package review UI
userStories.description: As a Forska user, I want a dedicated `/projects/import` wizard with upload and package review steps so I can inspect an import package before any write begins.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an `Import Project` action on the projects index page that navigates to `/projects/import`.
The import wizard supports file upload, package summary, omission warnings, and exact-duplicate warnings from the server-side session.
The UI reads server session state instead of storing extracted package details only in browser memory.
Verify in browser: `Import Project` opens `/projects/import` and the upload plus package review steps render session-backed summary data

userStories.title: Build dependency resolution and final plan review UI
userStories.description: As a Forska user, I want the import wizard to show dependency resolution and final plan review steps so I can confirm mappings before commit.
acceptanceCriteria: The wizard shows provider connection states, model mapping, article reuse versus creation, and omitted route links before confirmation.
Users can choose existing connections, create sanitized new connections, or launch Codex setup for unresolved Codex dependencies.
The confirm action stays blocked while required provider, model, article, or route decisions remain unresolved.
Verify in browser: the import wizard shows dependency resolution details and keeps confirmation blocked until blocking issues are resolved

userStories.title: Commit project, prompt, route, article, and link remapping
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the import commit transaction to create the new project and remap its core relationships so imported data never trusts source database ids.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit creates a new project row, detached prompt rows, project prompt links, project route links, article rows as needed, and project article links with remapped target ids.
`project_prompt.origin_project_id` points to the new imported project and `project_article.imported_from_project_id` remains `NULL`.
Article reuse fills missing target fields without overwriting richer existing target data.

userStories.title: Commit judgments, human judgments, reviews, and assessments
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want project transfer commit to remap judgment-family rows safely so imported review flows preserve the package's screening state.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit rewrites all judgment foreign keys to target ids and updates `project_id` plus `snapshot_project_id` to the new imported project.
Post-remap conflict detection respects article, prompt, model, content toggles, and `delete_generation` and blocks the import if any remaining conflict exists.
Commit re-links `judgment_assessment`, `judgment_human`, `judgment_human_summary`, and `review` rows to the imported project graph.

userStories.title: Finalize import session, refresh, and navigation
userStories.description: As a Forska user, I want completed imports to land on the new project with clear follow-up warnings so the transfer feels finished and trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful commit, record transfer history, mark the new project dirty, queue mart refresh, and move the session into a completed state with cleanup.
Finish flow navigates to the new imported project and surfaces post-import warnings for omitted route links or follow-up provider setup.
Failed, cancelled, and expired sessions clean up temp storage without leaving partial writes in the main tables.

userStories.title: Verify browser and desktop transfer flows end to end
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want end-to-end browser and desktop verification for project transfer so the finished feature is safe to ship across both supported runtimes.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser verification covers small export download, large export preparing state, import upload, dependency resolution, commit, and post-import project rendering.
Desktop verification covers package download, runtime-writable asset extraction, upload, duplicate warnings, and navigation to the imported project.
The final verification run confirms the imported project shows the expected prompts, articles, judgments, human judgments, and reviews after mart refresh.
Verify in browser: export a project package, import it through `/projects/import`, and confirm the imported project shows the expected prompts, articles, judgments, and reviews
Verify in desktop build: export and import the same package and confirm file picking, upload, and post-import project navigation work
